crab.reviewed_by: Codex: direct final native/comparison/world/icon inspection, not user sign-off
crab.notes: Own mesh, UV, pixels, rig and authored clips. Full original capabilities retained. Crab anatomy -Z, sideways travel +X maps to entity +Z: both runtime footprint and anatomical extents reported. Eight walking legs and two independent closing pincers per decapod; lobster six-part abdomen and tail fan. Octopus restored original orange/pale identity with eight 4-segment arms, separate crawl/swim and mantle pulse. Oblique tube distal rings fully child-weighted; actual skinning seam, stance, cycle and contact tests pass. Gameplay bounds, speed and habitat preserved. Initial shore-occluded worlds rejected; corrected open-water captures inspected. Die is asset capability, no runtime Death state. Eight-second art probes have performance gates disabled. Benthic routes/normal AI, compatibility and performance remain R6.
